title: Counter-Wait Credit on Conduct-Complaint Disputes — Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
Long waits at the store counter or the door are taken into account when a Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts shopper disputes a conduct-complaint violation.

**Which batch.** The batch is the one named on the conduct-complaint violation under dispute. Its waiting minutes are read from the batch record in Cartwise Shopper Batches, and the free waiting minutes are those the Cartwise Shopper Batches schedule sets for that batch type.

**Clause.** The counter-wait credit follows the waiting minutes recorded on the disputed violation's batch beyond the free waiting minutes of that batch type: an excess of 20 minutes or more gives a credit of 2 points; an excess from 10 minutes up to 19 minutes (one minute short of 20) gives 1 point; a smaller excess gives no credit.

| Waiting minutes beyond the batch type's free waiting minutes | Counter-wait credit |
|---|---|
| 20 or more | 2 points |
| 10 to 19 | 1 point |
| Fewer than 10 (or none) | None |

## Worked readings (hypothetical batches and free minutes)

| Waiting minutes on the batch | Free waiting minutes of its type (illustrative) | Excess | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 45 | 15 | 30 | 2 points |
| 35 | 15 | 20 | 2 points |
| 34 | 15 | 19 | 1 point |
| 25 | 15 | 10 | 1 point |
| 24 | 15 | 9 | None |

The excess is the batch's waiting minutes less the free waiting minutes of its own type.
